_comment: Generated from the frontmatter of docs/user/features/*.md by npm run docs:features. Edit the pages, not this file.

features.title: Cast from another Jellyfin app
features.pitch: Cast from a Jellyfin app on your phone or browser to your Roku, then pause, seek and skip from there.

features.title: Deep links for scripts and smart homes
features.pitch: Open or play anything in JellyRock from another device, a script or a voice routine, with only the item's ID.

features.title: Delete media
features.pitch: Delete a movie, an episode or any other item from your server, from its details page, when your account may.

features.title: HDR and Dolby Vision
features.pitch: Watch HDR10, HDR10+, HLG and Dolby Vision as they were made, on a 4K Roku and a TV that shows them.

features.title: Live TV and recordings
features.pitch: Watch live channels from your Jellyfin server, browse the TV guide, and schedule recordings from your couch.

features.title: Manage subtitles
features.pitch: Search your server's subtitle providers and download a subtitle onto a movie or episode from its page.

features.title: Media segments (skip intro and outro)
features.pitch: Skip the intros, outros, recaps, previews and commercials your server has marked, or get a button to skip them.

features.title: Surround sound
features.pitch: Hear 5.1 and 7.1 sound on your soundbar or receiver, kept as surround even when the server has to convert it.

features.title: SyncPlay (watch together)
features.pitch: Watch together. Join a SyncPlay group and play, pause and seek in step with people on other Jellyfin apps.

features.title: Watch in original quality
features.pitch: Play your files as they are, with no conversion, whenever your Roku can, and see why when it can't.
